Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026

This policy applies to iMyFinance, developed and published by American Group LLC, on iOS and Android.

ApplicationiMyFinance
iOS bundle idcom.americangroupllc.myfinance
Android packagecom.americangroupllc.myfinance
DeveloperAmerican Group LLC
Contactcontact@americangroup.ai

Accounts

The app does not require registration and does not create user accounts or profiles.

Device permissions

The app requests no camera, microphone, location, photo, contact or health permissions.

Advertising

The app shows ads served by Google Mobile Ads (AdMob). Google may use the device advertising identifier to serve and measure ads, as described in Google's privacy policy. Where required, the app asks for your consent before any ad is requested, and you can change that choice in the app's settings. We do not sell your personal information.

Purchases

The app has no in-app purchases.

Analytics and crash reporting

To find and fix problems, the app sends crash reports through Google Firebase Crashlytics (the error, the device model, operating system and app version, and a random installation identifier). This data is not linked to your name or account, is not used for advertising, and is processed by Google under Firebase's privacy terms.

Network

The app declares no network permission on Android and works entirely on your device.

Data retention and deletion

Data the app stores lives on your device and is removed when you uninstall the app.

Children

The app is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

Your rights

You may ask us to access, correct or delete personal data we hold about you by emailing contact@americangroup.ai. We answer within 30 days.

Changes

We will post any change to this policy on this page with a new date.
